overview.title: Experience Pharmacy Education Beyond the Classroom.
paragraphs: Build your knowledge, develop practical skills and grow your confidence through educational pharmacy games, practical dispensing activities and real-life pharmacy scenarios.
The Certificate Course in Pharmacy Practice at Ceylon Pharma College is designed to give you practical knowledge and essential skills in medicines and pharmacy practice.

Whether you are planning to enter the pharmacy field, already working in a pharmacy, or simply want to improve your pharmaceutical knowledge, this course gives you a strong foundation for your next step.

Build practical knowledge in medicines, dispensing, pharmaceutical calculations and everyday pharmacy practice through an interactive learning experience designed for aspiring and current pharmacy professionals.

audience.title: Who Is This Course For?
items: Individuals planning to start a career in the pharmacy field
Pharmacy assistants who want to strengthen their knowledge and skills
People already working in pharmacies who want structured professional learning
Learners interested in medicines, dispensing and pharmacy practice
Anyone looking for a practical introduction to pharmacy-related knowledge
audience.note: No advanced pharmaceutical background is required to begin.

features.title: More Than Just Lectures — What Makes CPC Different?
features.intro: At Ceylon Pharma College, we believe pharmacy education should go beyond simply listening to lectures and memorising medicines. Our students learn by understanding, practising, participating and applying knowledge.
features.closing: Not Just Lectures. Learn Through Games, Practical Activities and Real Pharmacy Examples.

learn.title: Learn Beyond Memorising Medicines
learn.intro: Pharmacy practice requires more than remembering medicine names. During this course, students develop an understanding of:
items: How medicine doses and quantities are calculated
How pharmaceutical knowledge is applied in real-life situations
learn.closing: Our goal is to help students move from simply knowing information to understanding how to use it.

items.title: Foundations of Pharmacy Practice
items.description: Understand the role of pharmacy personnel, professional responsibilities and the basic structure of pharmacy practice.

items.title: Medical Terminology
items.description: Learn common medical and pharmaceutical terms used in prescriptions, medicine labels and healthcare communication.

items.title: Dosage Forms & Drug Administration
items.description: Understand tablets, capsules, liquids, creams, inhalers, injections and other dosage forms, including common routes of administration.

items.title: Pharmaceutical Packaging & Quality Assurance
items.description: Learn the importance of medicine packaging, labelling, storage and maintaining product quality.

items.title: Prescription Handling & Safe Medication Practices
items.description: Develop an understanding of prescription terminology, medicine instructions, dispensing safety and common medication errors.

items.title: Pharmaceutical Calculations
items.description: Learn calculations used in pharmacy practice, including doses, quantities and medicine measurements.

items.title: Assisting in Dispensing Medications
items.description: Understand the basic dispensing process, prescription interpretation, labelling and medicine handling.

items.title: Therapeutics of Common Diseases
items.description: Learn commonly used medicines for major health conditions and understand their basic uses, actions and important safety considerations.

items.title: Pharmacy Law & Regulations
items.description: Gain an introduction to the legal and professional requirements relevant to pharmacy practice.

items.title: Practical Pharmacy Skills
items.description: Apply your knowledge through activities, pharmacy scenarios, educational games and practical learning exercises.

items.question: Do I need previous pharmacy experience?
items.answer: No. The course is designed to provide a foundation in pharmacy practice and can also support learners who already have some pharmacy experience.

items.question: Is the course online?
items.answer: Yes. Classes are conducted through live Zoom sessions.

items.question: Can I watch recorded lessons?
items.answer: Yes. Recorded lessons are available for revision.

items.question: Will I receive study materials?
items.answer: Yes. Students receive a printed study pack.

items.question: Are there practical activities?
items.answer: Yes. The programme includes practical learning activities, pharmacy examples and educational games.

items.question: Will I receive a certificate?
items.answer: Students who successfully complete the programme requirements receive a certificate from Ceylon Pharma College.
